title: AntGarden - Rouge Survivor In the Yard
author: Old-Wolverine-4134
selftext:
Little demo I did with Opus and Unity. You are shrunk down to ant size and have to fight your way out of the  garden yard. Enemies include ants, beetles, exploding ants and more. You have powerups and upgrades, including exploding seed and companion bee.

At the end of the level a ladybug flies in and carries you above the tall grass to the next region.

It used around 20% of my weekly limit ($100 sub). Took about a day to polish it, but still needs more bug fixes and visual edits.

replies.body:
Oh I see.

Well, again, the environment is a 10/10 though

comments.author: Ok_Improvement_8735
comments.body: Could you please explain more how you got this done in a day? Did you have your visual and audio assets ready already or did the ai make them? Did you connect opus to unity with mcp? What were your prompts like?

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body:
AI made absolutely everything you see. Interesting part is Claude did not have "visual connection" to unity. I did not allow it to preview the game so it mostly build it by my prompts. I started with the basics - what type of game and camera I want. Then terrain. Then plants. Then player. Then one by one the enemies. Later added water puddles, soda cans, leaves, nails and other small stuff. In the end I allowed it to see the game and do a visual pass on it to improve on the graphics. The video here got compressed a lot, but the game actually looks better.

Almost forgot - I asked Claude to use my ChatGPT for some art, because Opus is pretty bad at it.

replies.author: Ok_Improvement_8735
replies.body: For the art it's with ChatGPT image generation? Do you have to do anything in particular to rig the motion and get the animations like walking and such?

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body:
The art and textures are done with ChatGPT by Opus 5.5 - i.e. Claude uses its browser to open ChatGPT and generate whatever it needs.

For the animations - i did nothing, Opus did everything by itself. With that said the main player animation is very stiff and basic, but for now it works.
